# Copilot instructions for the Atomus repo

Read `AGENTS.md` at the repo root first. It has the repo map, build commands, the list of generated files and the AI policy.

- **Edit sources, not generated copies.** Docs pages under `sites/docs/src/content/docs/foundations/`, `components/` and `ai/rules.mdx` are generated from `guidelines/` by `sites/docs/scripts/sync.mjs`. The "React API" sections in `guidelines/components/*.md` and `skills/atomus/references/` are generated by `node scripts/build-skill.mjs`.
- **AI policy:** never add or change tokens, disable lint rules, type checks or tests, or change thresholds without human review. Tokens come from the Figma file.
- **Checks:** `node scripts/build-skill.mjs --check` and `cd sites/docs && npm run build` must pass.

When you write UI code here, follow `guidelines/Guidelines.md`:

- Pick components with `guidelines/overview-components.md`; use only the props in each component's "React API" section of `guidelines/components/<name>.md`.
- Use semantic tokens only (`var(--color-text-primary)`, `var(--layout-md)`, Tailwind `bg-secondary`). No raw hex, `rgb()` or primitive tokens such as `--color-gray-500`.
- One `hierarchy="primary"` button per view; put custom content in slots (`children`, `footer`, `actions`).
- Validate changed UI files with `node skills/atomus/scripts/validate.mjs <files>`.
